features.title: Partition Freshness Policy Management
acceptance: Define partition freshness policies with max age and grace seconds
Optimistic version concurrency checks prevent lost updates

features.title: Replay-Safe Materialization Ingestion
acceptance: Ingest replay-safe materializations with idempotency on duplicate event IDs
Reject conflicting materializations and future timestamps

features.title: Source-Watermark Freshness Evaluation & Incident Recovery
acceptance: Evaluate source-watermark freshness against policy deadlines
Open, track, and resolve stale and missing incidents transactionally

features.title: Administrator Audit Log & Incident Timeline
acceptance: Record admin audit logs for policy and ingestion events
Track cursor-paginated timeline of incident transitions

features.title: OIDC PKCE Authentication & Role-Based Access Control
acceptance: Authenticate users via Keycloak OIDC authorization code flow with PKCE and state/nonce validation
Enforce role-based access control across viewer, operator, and admin roles

features.title: Provider-Neutral AI Freshness Explanations
acceptance: Provide opt-in advisory explanations grounded in actual partition health
Support multiple providers with explicit unavailable states without fabricating responses

features.title: Batch Ingestion, Health Filtering & Snapshot Export
acceptance: Ingest atomic batches of materializations with replay reporting
Export complete feature health, policy, and incident snapshots as JSON
Filter and search partitions in operator workspace

features.title: Materialization Event History and Ingestion Telemetry
acceptance: Query recent materialization events for a feature set with optional partition filter and limit pagination
Return event ID, partition, source watermark, completed at, row count, and ingestion receipt timestamp
Surface materialization event history table in the operator console with partition filtering and empty state
Reject unauthorized unauthenticated or malformed requests

features.title: Configurable Webhook Alert Dispatcher
acceptance: Dispatch signed HTTP webhook notifications to registered endpoints when incidents open or resolve
